text:
Alyssa: Quick heads-up — onboarding the new 6B-quant model. I put weights at gs://redwood-models/onboard/6b-quant/v1/
Ben: Thanks — will grab. Any tokenizer notes?
Alyssa: Yes. Carlos saw weird extra token at start when prompt begins with a newline. Could affect prefix caching and batching.
Carlos: Repro steps I used:
```
input = "\nHuman: What's the weather?\nAssistant:"
ids = tokenizer.encode(input)
# first id looks like special BOS (1001) + then normal tokens
```
Ben: Hmm, tokenizer should not emit explicit BOS for this model. Which tokenizer package/version?
Alyssa: tokenizer.json from the weights dir: gs://redwood-models/onboard/6b-quant/v1/tokenizer.json (commit: 0a9f)
Erin: I can run a quick smoke. If BOS is present it could double-count in our prompt wrapping. Will test with chat templates.
InfraBot: Deploy preview env created: preview-6b-quant-2026-03-18 (ip: 10.12.5.8)
Frank: Quick config note: model config has `add_bos=true` in model_config.yaml. Maybe upstream toolset expects `add_bos=false`.
Alyssa: Good catch. I inherited that flag from the repo template. The runtime already has prefix-add logic; double adding is bad.
Carlos: Also saw sentinel token mapping mismatch for `</s>` vs `<|endoftext|>`. Token ids differ (1002 vs 1). Some eval prompts use `</s>` literal.
Ben: We'll need a compatibility shim: map both forms to the runtime's EOS id or normalize prompts at preprocess.
Jade (PM): Impact on rollout? If some customers hit off-by-one token counts, billing + prompt truncation could surface.
Alyssa: Short-term: set `add_bos=false` in model_config.yaml and add a quick normalizer in the serving config. Long-term: update tokenizer to canonicalize sentinels.
Erin: Running tests now. I'll post before/after token streams.
Ben: If Erin reproduces, I can cut a hotfix PR for model configs and bump the onboard checklist.
Frank: Also adding a linter check in the onboarding pipeline: ensure model_config add_bos aligns with tokenizer meta["expects_bos"]
Carlos: Test output (current):
```
# token ids
[1001, 34, 785, 900, 2, 1002]
# expected (after fix)
[34, 785, 900, 2, 1002]
```
Erin: Confirmed locally. When `add_bos=true` runtime prefix + tokenizer bos => duplicated 1001.
Alyssa: OK action items:
- Erin -> run full prompt-suite and paste failing prompts in this thread (ETA 2h)
- Ben -> PR for model_config.yaml default change + onboarding checklist update (ETA EOD)
- Frank -> add linter rule in pipeline (ETA 1d)
- Carlos -> prepare a short note for docs re: sentinel normalization (ETA 2d)
- Jade -> flag customer-facing bucket for rollout notes
Jade (PM): noted, will include in release notes and customer comms if needed.
Ben: One more question — quantized artifact name is `6b-quant-v1.q4_0.safetensors` right?
Alyssa: Yes. That's the one in the gs bucket. Also uploaded a non-quant for eval: `6b-v1.safetensors`.
Carlos: For the serving config, I'll add a `token_normalization: ["</s>", "<|endoftext|>"]` hook — runtime will map to eos_id.
InfraBot: Canary deploy scheduled: preview-6b-quant-2026-03-18 -> canary group 10% at 2026-03-18T15:20Z
Frank: Heads-up: batching could mask the duplicate-bos in some logs — check both single-request and batched flows.
Erin: Pasted failing prompt set here: small set of templates that include leading newline and special sentinel combos.
Ben: Awesome. If tests pass, I'll merge the config PR and trigger a new preview deploy.
Alyssa: Thanks y'all. Ping me if you need the weights perms changed.
Carlos: LGTM on plan. :thumbsup:
Erin: Tests green for chat and text-gen; will run evals overnight and report.
Frank: I'll get the linter up tomorrow morning.
Jade (PM): Good coordination. Marking as "onboard-in-progress" in the tracker.
Alyssa: closing the loop later today — will update the checklist entry once PR merges. :rocket:
